s: Ezeh mechitztza qaruy mechitztza letaltel ubo k"b seipim: kol mechitztzot shello naasu kede ladur betokan, dehaynu liknisa vitzia tamid (ayyen simman shn"ch gabbe qarpep), ella lishmor mah sheyyannichu betokan o lesheb betokan lishmor hassadot, sheeno dar ba yomam valayla ella mistopep betzillah bilbad keshehachamma omedet alayv (abal sukka sheddar bah hashshomer yomam valayla — dira meulla hi, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch), veken mechitztzot haasuyin litzniut bealma, kegon habbannaim shebbonim bachamma veosin mechitztza lehagen alehem mippene hachamma, veken haaksadra shebbonim betok happardes (shettashmish mechitztza zo gam ken eno qabua lehitlonen betzillah apillu yom velayla echad biqbiut, ella keshehachamma qoderet bilbad, abal mechitztza haasuya leyom velayla echad — dira meulla hi, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"s). Vekol mechitztzot ellu, ap al pi shehen mechitztzot gemurot min hattora vehazzoreq letokan mereshut harabbim chayyab apillu yesh betokan kamma milin, mikkol maqom middibre soperim en metaltelin betokan ella bed' ammot im yesh betokan yoter mibbet satayim, mippene shehen enan chashubot muqqapot ledira. Abal ad bet satayim vead biklal, muttar letaltel bekol hammuqqap:

Lepikak ilan sheanapayv yoredin lematta kol sebibo, im enam gebohim g' tepachim min haaretz veiqqaran bemaqom shemmechubbarim lailan hu gaboah y' tepachim — hare hem chashubim mechitztza umuttar letaltel betokan ap al pi shello naasu ledira. Vehu sheyyemalle haavir shebben haanapim beetzim o beqash viqashsherem sham kede shello yenidem haruach, shekkol mechitztza sheenah yekola laamod beruach metzuya enah mechitztza. Vehu haddin im en gebohim y' tepachim bemaqom shemmechubbarim lailan, ella shebbaemtza hem gebohim asara, sheasuyim keqeshet. Vetzarik sheyyehe benehem d' al d' bekol gobah asara, sheim en benehem d' ella millematta measara veelak — hare hen kekarmelit:

Vekol zeh ad bet satayim, abal yoter mibbet satayim — asur. Vaapillu nata hailan mittechilla leshem kak, kede sheyyihyu anapayv mechitztzot sebibo, lehattir sham hattiltul — en zeh moil kelum, kevan sheeno asuy ladur bo ella lehistopep betzillo lishmor hassadot. Abal im hu asuy ladur bo, vaapillu lo netao mittechilla kede ladur bo, ella shemmille qash ben haanapim kede ladur bo — im rob haddopen min haqqash hamemalle sham ledira, hare zeh keillu kol haddopen asuy ledira, umetaltelin sham apillu beyoter missatayim (vaapillu sheen berochab haqqash yoter meeser — muttar. Veim yesh berochbo yoter meeser, ap al pi sheeno rob haddopen — gam ken muttar, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch):

Tel sheggaboah h' tepachim, veasa alayv mechitztza h' tepachim — hare zeh al gabbayv reshut hayyachid gemura lekol dabar, shehare yesh kan mechitztza y' tepachim, haynu h' tepachim min gobah atzmo, sheomerim bo "gud asseq mechitztza" lemala, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h, veHashem tepachim min hammechitztza, shehammechitztza ve"gud" mitztorpin. Mechitztza haomedet meeleha, dehaynu shello naaset leshem mechitztza — keshera lekol dabar:

Mechitztza shennaaset beshabbat beshogeg, keshera lekol dabar. Bemezid — mechitztza hi lehachamir, lechayyeb hazzoreq mittokah lirshut harabbim, abal lo lehaqel, lehattir hattiltul betokah, mishshum qenas. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello hayeta sham mechitztza kelal bitchillat hashshabbat. Abal im hayeta sham vehesirah vechazar vaasaa — apillu bemezid chozra lehetterah harishon:

Vekol zeh keshehammechitztza hi birshut harabbim o bekarmelit, veal yadah naasa sham reshut hayyachid. Abal im gam belo mechitztza zo yesh sham od mechitztzot, sheal yadan naasa sham reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, ella shehaya asur letaltel sham middibre soperim — moelet mechitztza zo lehattir letaltel sham, vaapillu lo hayeta bitchillat hashshabbat venaaset beshabbat bemezid. Veim hayeta sham bitchillat hashshabbat venopla achar kak — muttar apillu lo chozra venaaset kelal, shekkevan sheggam mibbaladeha yesh sham od mechitztzot, hare anu omerim "shabbat — kevan shehuttera, huttera":

Ketzad? Kegon shenayim o shelosha shehiqqipu bemachtzelaot sebibotehem birshut harabbim o bekarmelit, vehibdilu gam benehem, velo erebu yachad, vehaya kol echad muttar letaltel beshello, ubeshabbat niglelu hammachtzelaot shebbenehem — anu omerim "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", kevan sheggam mibbalade hammachtzelaot shebbenehem hayeta reshut hayyachid gemura al yede machtzelaot harishonot. Veim qodem hashshabbat lo hayu machtzelaot perusot benehem, venipresu beshabbat, apillu bemezid — muttar. Abal machtzelaot hachitzonot shennipresu beshabbat bemezid enan moilot, ella im ken hayu kebar perusot bitchillat hashshabbat veniglelu vechazeru venipresu. Veim lo chazeru venipresu, en omerim bahem "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", hoil veen kan mechitztzot hammapsiqot ben reshut harabbim o karmelit gemura. (Abal qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shello huqqap ledira, ap al pi shehu kekarmelit middibre soperim, kevan shemmin hattora hu reshut hayyachid gemura — omerim bo "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"s):

Veken shette sepinot shebbayyam shehen qeshurot zo bezo veerebu yachad, ubeshabbat nipsequ — en omerim bahen "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", lepi shekkeshennipsequ hare zeh keillu hayyam mapsiq benehen, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"h, vehayyam hu karmelit gemura. Abal im chazeru veniqsheru, apillu bemezid — chazeru lehetteran harishon, kevan shemmibbalade zeh hayu shettehen reshut hayyachid:

Sepina — muttar letaltel bekulla apillu hi yoter mibbet satayim, mippene shechashuba lemuqqepet dira. Veen omerim mechitztzoteha lehabriach mayim naasu, shello ledira. Veen tzarik lomar im kepaah ladur tachteha, shekkepiyyatah — zo hi asiyyat mechitztzatah ledirat matta, venaasa al yede ken muqqepet ledira gam al gabbah milmala mishshum "gud asseq". Abal im kepaah lezappetah — en metaltelin bah, ben tachteha ben aleha, ella bed' ammot im hi yoter missatayim, mippene shebbittel mechitztzoteha mittorat dira bikpiyyatan zo, sheenan omedot kol zeman kepiyyatan lo ledirat matta velo ledirat mala:

Bakkol osin mechitztza mibbeod yom, apillu bekelim veukkapot haggebohim y' tepachim, ap al pi shessopan lehinnatel achar hashshabbat. Vaapillu mechitztzot shel ereb belo sheti, kegon shel chabalim hammetuchim al gabbe yetedot sabib chebel al gabbe chebel begobah y' tepachim, o shel sheti belo ereb, kegon qanim haggebohim asara hanneutzim baaretz zeh etzel zeh — hare zeh moelet ad bet satayim, apillu leyachid beyishshub, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"s. Ubilbad shello yihyeh ben chebel lachabero o ben qaneh lachabero g' tepachim. Vekol avir shehu pachot mig' tepachim nechshab kesatum legamre. Abal im yesh apillu ben chebel echad lachabero g' tepachim — eno mechitztza kelal, (ella im ken haavir shel g' tepachim hu baemtza) veyesh mechebel haelyon shel g' tepachim hallalu ad chebel haelyon shebberosh gobah hammechitztza yoter mig' tepachim satum bachabalim, umechebel hattachton shel g' tepachim avir hallalu satum gam ken bachabalim ad pachot mishshelosha samuk laaretz, sheim en mechebel haelyon shel g' tepachim hallalu ad chebel haelyon shebberosh gobah hammechitztza ella g' tepachim setumim bachabalim — hare haavir shemmitztzad zeh umitztzad zeh leg' tepachim hallalu hassetumim, dehaynu haavir haelyon shead chebel shebberashe gobah hammechitztza im haavir shel g' tepachim hallalu, baim umebattelim hag' tepachim setumim shebbenehem. Abal im hassatum yoter mig' tepachim, azay en avir zeh mebattel hassatum shealayv, hoil vehu merubbeh mimmennu. Vekol zeh ben chebel lechebel. Abal im yesh avir g' tepachim mehaaretz ad chebel hattachton, apillu mishsham veelak satum legamre yoter mimmea amma — en zo mechitztza, hoil vehaggedayim yekolim libqoa tachteha, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"h:

Vekol zeh bachabalim. Abal beqanim, im yesh ben qaneh echad lachabero g' tepachim o yoter, ad eser ammot — en hammechitztza nipselet bishbil zeh, ella im ken happarutz merubbeh al haomed kemo sheyyitbaer. Vaapillu im yesh avir samuk liqtzeh hammechitztza, velo nishar sham omed yoter meeser ad haqqatzeh — en omerim sheyyabo avir zeh im avir haolam shechutz laqqatzeh vibattelu omed hannishar meavir zeh ad haqqatzeh, lepi sheen omerim shehaavir mebattel haomed ella baavir shehu nechshab kesatum al yede haomed, kegon haavir shebbetok hammechitztza vehaavir shellemala ad laraqia, shehu nechshab gam ken kesatum kesheyyesh tachtayv omed gaboah asara. Abal avir haolam shechutz liqtzeh hammechitztza en nechshab kesatum kelal al yede haomed, velaken eno mebattelo kelal:

Apillu mibbaale chayyim osim mechitztza, sheyyaamid sham behema ledopen mibbeod yom umuttar letaltel sham beshabbat, ubilbad shettehe qeshura sham, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shs"g. Veim hechalal shebben haraglayim gaboah g' tepachim — tzarik ligdor sham beqanim:

Vaapillu beshabbat muttar laasot mechitztza mehaanashim haomedim zeh etzel zeh bepachot mig' tepachim, lepi sheen derek binyan bekak (shehare haadam hu ben daat veomed ledaat atzmo, mah sheen ken behema shehi keetz bealma vehaamadatah limchitztza doma lebinyan) vaapillu keshehem mehallekim chashubim mechitztza ubenehem reshut hayyachid gemura (im hu beinyan sheyyesh mehem ked' mechitztzot maqqipot lechalal shebbenehem):

Bammeh debarim amurim shemmuttar lehaamidam beshabbat? Ella keshehem enam yodeim shelleshem mechitztza hu maamidem sham (shekkevan shehem enam mitkavvenim limchitztza, vehem bene daat veomedim ladaat atzman, en bezeh mishshum asiyyat mechitztza beshabbat). Abal im apillu echad mehem yodea — asur lehaamidam. Veim abar veheemidam bemezid, dinam kimchitztza hannaaset bemezid beshabbat shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu im lo hodiam atta sheoseh mehem mechitztzot, im qarob haddabar sheyyedeu, kegon sheasa mehem mechitztza paam achat venoda lahem kebar — lo yaaseh hu mehem mechitztza od, shemma yargishu baddabar terem sheyyaspiqu ligmor asiyyat hammechitztza veachar kak yigmeruha, venimtza naaset beissur. Abal yesh lehistappeq im adam acher rashshay laasot mehem mechitztza od (usepeq dibre soperim lehaqel):

Vaapillu kesheoseh mehem mechitztza paam rishona, im maamidem techilla kimchitztzot, veachar kak molikem kak kede letaltel benehem keshehem mehallekim — qarob haddabar sheyyargishu baddabar qodem sheyyigmor holakatam otam kimchitztzot, kevan sheheemidam techilla veachar kak molikam, vehu holek benehem. Velo hittiru letaltel benehem derek hillukam ella keshehem mehallekim meatzmam:

Im bau techilla shello ladaat, ap al pi sheachar kak hirgishu baddabar, leachar shennaasa mehem hammechitztzot, qodem shehispiq letaltel benehem — en bekak kelum, kevan shebbishat asiyyat hammechitztza hayeta shello ladaat:

En laasot mechitztza shel bene adam ella bishat hatztzorek ubishat haddechaq. Veim shakach chepetz birshut harabbim — yoter tob leholik sham tinoqot, vehem yagbihu hachepetz mealehem vibiuhu labbayit, mishsheyyaaseh mechitztzot shel bene adam vibiennu gadol. Vehu sheen hattinoq yodea shechepetz zeh hu shel abiv, velahanaat atzmo hu mitkavven bahabaato oto, shessabur shemmatza chepetz birshut harabbim. Abal im yodea shechepetz zeh shel abiv, hare hu mitkavven min hassetam bahabaato bishbil abiv, vetzarik kol adam limchot betinoq zeh shello yebiennu kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"d, vekol shekken shello yolikennu shamma kede sheyyebiennu (vehu haddin im hachepetz hu shel acher, vehattinoq yodeo umakkiro vibiennu elayv). Vekol zeh baacherim. Abal abiv metzuvveh lechanneko veligor bo ulehaprisho kesheroehu mechallel shabbat apillu lahanaat atzmo, vaapillu beissure dibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"g, vekol shekken shello yolikennu shamma kede sheyyebiennu, apillu en hachepetz shello:

Kol heqqep mechitztzot shehapparutz shebbo merubbeh al haomed — asur, ukeillu kullo parutz, ella im ken kol pirtza mehem pechuta mig' tepachim. Abal im happarutz keomed shaveh beshaveh — muttar (ben bimchitztzot shel sheti ben bimchitztzot shel ereb), shekkak hi halaka lemosheh missinay — shello yihyeh harob parutz, velo sheyyehe tzarik harob omed, ubilbad shello yihyeh bemaqom echad parutz yoter meeser ammot. Abal ad eser vead biklal — muttar, mippene shehu kepetach:

Im asa tzurat petach, apillu lepirtza yetera meeser — muttar, mippene sheen kan parutz kelal. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechatzer umaboy sheyyesh bahem diyyurim umaqqipim otam ledira velo bishbil hetter tiltul bilbad, laken moil bahem kesheheqqep diratam hu al yede tzurat petach mid' ruchot. Abal bebiqa shebba laasot bah heqqep kede lehattir letaltel betoko, eno moil middibre soperim keshekkol had' ruchot muqqapot al yede tzurat petach bilbad. Abal im haheqqep hu ketiqquno, ella sheyyesh bo peratzot yeterot al eser — moil bahen tzurat petach, apillu im happarutz merubbeh al haomed. Veyesh omerim sheen tzurat petach moil lepirtza yetera meeser apillu bechatzer, ella im ken omed merubbeh al happarutz, o beruach shelishit shel maboy, kemo shennitbaer besimman (shs"g) [shs"d]. Abal lepirtzat eser moil tzurat petach apillu parutz merubbeh al haomed. Vaapillu kol had' ruchot hen al yede tzurat petach, veen bahen ella eser al eser — muttar, apillu bebiqa. Vetob lachush ledibrehem ap al pi shehaiqqar kisbara rishona:

Mahu tzurat petach? Qaneh mikkan veqaneh mikkan, apillu echad rachoq mechabero, veqaneh al gabbehem, apillu eno nogea bahem ella yesh benehem kamma ammot, ubilbad sheyyehe gobah haqqanim shemmikkan umikkan y' tepachim, veyihyu mekuvvanim keneged qaneh haelyon, sheaz domeh lepetach, shehammashqop nittan al hammezuzot. Abal im hem meruchaqim mikkenegdo apillu kol shehu — pasul, sheeno domeh lepetach. Veken im chibber qaneh elyon lishne haqqanim o leechad mehem min hatztzad, veeno natun al gabbo milmala — sheeno domeh lepetach, shehammashqop nittan al gabbe hammezuzot milmala — gam ken pasul. Veim asa gam qaneh acher mekuvvan tachat haelyon, mikkol maqom yesh lishlop qaneh happasul mippene marit haayin. Veim asa chebel al haqqanim — yesh omerim sheim hu karuk berashe haqqanim mammash, sheeno bolet kelum mehaqqanim lemala mehachebel, kasher, ap al pi sheen hachebel natun al gabbe rashe haqqanim mammash, ella karuk sham al tziddehem. Vetob lehachamir lekorko al gabbe rashe haqqaneh mammash:
Haqqanim shemmikkan umikkan tzerikim sheyyihyu chazaqim leqabbel delet kol shehu, apillu shel qash o shel qanim. Abal qaneh haelyon day bekol shehu, vaapillu hu shel gemi:
Shaar heasuy beiggul kekippa, im yesh gobah y' tepachim beraglayv, dehaynu qodem sheyyatchil lehitaggel — mattir mishshum tzurat petach:
